Under the guidance and supervision of the Human Resources Manager and within the established Rixos Hotel Standards, the Human Resources Assistant Manager is responsible for assisting the Human Resources Manager in managing the day-to-day operations of the People & Culture Department. The role supports the implementation of HR policies and procedures, coordinates various HR functions, assists in supervising departmental activities, and provides guidance and support to HR team members.

The position contributes to the smooth functioning of the department by ensuring efficient HR administration, effective employee services, accurate documentation, and compliance with company policies and applicable labor regulations.
Assist the Human Resources Manager in coordinating and managing the day-to-day operations of the People & Culture Department.
Support and coordinate HR team members in carrying out their daily responsibilities and administrative tasks.
Maintain and monitor employee personnel files, records, and HR documentation, ensuring accuracy and confidentiality.
Ensure employee information is properly updated in the HR Management System (HRMS).
Coordinate documentation related to recruitment, onboarding, transfers, promotions, resignations, and other employment changes.
Assist in implementing and maintaining HR policies, procedures, operational guidelines, and departmental standards.
Prepare monthly HR reports and other administrative summaries as required.
Monitor departmental timesheets and ensure accurate attendance records.
Coordinate the distribution of employee handbooks, identification cards, and name tags.
Assist the Human Resources Manager in coordinating recruitment activities in collaboration with Department Heads and the Recruitment Team.
Follow up on job applications, candidate correspondence, recruitment documentation, and hiring procedures.
Coordinate onboarding arrangements for new employees, including flight bookings, airport pickups, accommodation, and joining formalities.
Assist in monitoring recruitment progress and workforce requirements.
Coordinate with relevant departments and external service providers to ensure a smooth recruitment and onboarding process.
Provide professional, courteous, and timely assistance to employees and colleagues.
Assist the Human Resources Manager in addressing employee concerns and resolving workplace matters.
Maintain effective communication with employees, Department Heads, and management regarding HR updates and important announcements.
Support employee engagement initiatives and coordinate social and recreational activities in collaboration with Department Heads.
Conduct exit interviews with resigning employees and assist in identifying resignation trends and areas for improvement.
Maintain strict confidentiality when handling employee information and sensitive matters.
Promote a positive working environment and contribute to employee satisfaction.
Coordinate and follow up on the annual performance evaluation process across all employee levels.
Assist in administering employee insurance and report any discrepancies or irregularities to the Human Resources Manager.
Maintain monthly records of employees' annual leave and public holiday balances.
Coordinate with the Finance Department regarding payroll documentation, salary information, and other finance-related matters.
Support the administration of employee benefits and entitlements.
Follow up with relevant departments to ensure employee requests and benefits are processed in a timely manner.
Assist the Human Resources Manager in monitoring adherence to company remuneration guidelines and reporting any deviations.
Support the review and administration of compensation and employee benefits policies.
Coordinate with Department Heads regarding workforce requirements and operational staffing needs.
Assist in preparing relevant workforce reports and employee-related data.
Assist in coordinating and monitoring staff accommodation arrangements and related services.
Conduct regular accommodation inspections and follow up on maintenance, repairs, pest control, and improvement requirements.
Coordinate employee transportation, travel arrangements, and other related services.
Ensure new employee accommodation and airport pickup arrangements are completed before arrival.
Assist in ensuring compliance with applicable Saudi labor laws, immigration regulations, employee work permits, and statutory requirements.
Monitor employee documentation validity and follow up on renewals and necessary government procedures.
Assist in ensuring relevant hotel licenses and permits are valid and up to date.
Maintain accurate HR documentation and support internal and external audit requirements.
Assist in implementing company policies, procedures, and operational standards.
Attend departmental meetings and prepare meeting minutes for circulation.
Support compliance with hotel Health, Safety, Risk Management, and ISO Integrated Management System requirements.
Assist the Human Resources Manager in preparing departmental reports and monitoring HR activities.
Provide administrative and operational support to the Human Resources Manager and all People & Culture team members.
Coordinate with Recruitment, Employee Benefits, Employee Relations, PRO, and Visa Coordination to ensure smooth departmental operations.
Maintain effective communication and coordination with the Finance Department, Department Heads, external service providers, and government entities.
Assist in supervising and coordinating the daily activities of the HR team as assigned by the Human Resources Manager.
Attend all required training sessions and meetings.
Perform any other reasonable duties assigned by the Human Resources Manager or General Manager.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Business Management, or a related field.
Minimum of 1 year of experience in a similar HR role, within the hospitality industry.
Previous experience in HR operations, coordination, or team supervision.
Good understanding of HR policies, procedures, and practices.
Knowledge of Saudi Labor Law and relevant government platforms.
Experience in HR administration, employee relations, and recruitment coordination.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and HR Management Systems.
Excellent command of Arabic and English.

Healthcare or another highly regulated sector.
UAE or Abu Dhabi regulatory matters.
UAE data protection and privacy requirements.
Dealings with UAE government authorities, regulators and notaries.
Bilingual Arabic-English legal drafting or legal translation.
In-house legal operations or contract management.
